ios.desc:
Check ROAD CONDITIONS and WEATHER on your ROUTE

• Be PREPARED for the road trip
• Say NO to weather delays
• Know EVERYTHING about weather conditions at any point of your road trip
• Be smarter than 99% of drivers around you!
• Access weather and radar on CarPlay

 
Forecast That Follows Your Trip
Weather and navigation combined to provide a route forecast precisely at the time you will be driving through. It's the best weather app you can have on the road. 

Features and benefits:
• Know What's Ahead Before You Get There — See exact weather at every point along your route at the time you'll actually be there
• Leave at the Right Time — Adjust your departure up to 7 days out and instantly find the safest, clearest weather window
• Choose the Smartest Route — Compare alternative routes side by side and take the one with the best conditions
• Never Be Caught Off Guard by Rain or Snow — Live Doppler radar shows real-time precipitation moving toward your route
• Get the Full Picture, Not Just the Temperature — Wind speed, gusts, UV index, visibility, and weather warnings all in one view
• Live Traffic Cameras Along Your Route — View real-time DOT camera feeds along your drive and see exactly what road conditions look like before you get there.
• Plan Multi-Stop Trips With Confidence — Add waypoints and stop durations so your forecast stays accurate across every leg of the journey
• Stay Focused on the Road — Full Apple CarPlay support delivers hands-free weather updates on your dashboard
• Avoid Driving Into Blinding Sun — Sunrise and sunset times are plotted right on your route timeline so you're never caught off guard
• Your Data Stays Yours — No ads, no tracking, no location stored. Just clean, accurate forecasting across 70+ countries

Free & Pro Plans

Free: 
Download and start using Weather on the Way at no cost. Core route forecasting features are included so you can get a feel for the app before committing.

Pro Monthly or Yearly:
Unlock the full power of the app including alternative route comparison, flexible departure time planning and all advanced weather layers. The yearly plan includes a free one-week trial so you can try Pro risk-free.

One-Time Purchase:
Not a fan of subscriptions? A lifetime purchase option is also available, giving you permanent access to all Pro features with a single payment.

Weather on the Way runs on iPhones with iOS 15 and newer.
Strict commitment to user privacy - both the app and our website collects NO personal info

quotes.text: On iOS, there is the "Weather on the Way" app, https://apps.apple.com/us/app/on-the-way-road-trip-planner/id1471394318.  I bet there's something similar on Android: perhaps search using terms from this app's description to find the closest analog.
